What to Include

Students (CSUMB)

Tell me which course you're in, what kind of research you're interested in, and what your schedule looks like. If you're thinking about AGPS 397, mention that.

Prospective grad students / postdocs

Send a brief statement of your research interests, your CV, and what kind of questions you want to work on. Be specific about why this lab and this program.

Collaborators

Describe the project or question briefly, the timeline, and what role you're imagining. I'm open to new collaborations but most productive when there's a clear question to start from.

Growers and industry partners

Tell me about the crop, the challenge, and the geography. Even if it's informal — a short note about what's going wrong or what you're curious about — I'd love to hear it.

Media and press

Feel free to reach out directly. I'm happy to discuss research topics related to water, vegetable crops, drought physiology, or California agriculture.

Caetano Albuquerque
